title: Verdict Row — Fleet Status

window.basis: The standing checker (check.py) retains only its latest run — state.json is overwritten on every run and no multi-run checker history exists — so ok_share is computed over the 1 run actually recorded: 1.0 when the route was ok on that run, 0.0 when it was failing. It is a last-check share, not a long-window uptime SLO.
